arguments.value: This agreement is between Hyatt Franchising Latin America, L.L.C. and Playa Hotels & Resorts, B.V. It ends their prior master development agreement and creates a strategic alliance for Hyatt Ziva and Hyatt Zilara all-inclusive resorts in Mexico, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Jamaica, and Panama. From the effective date of December 14, 2016 through December 31, 2018, each party must give the other a right of first offer on certain resort development opportunities in the market area, and if a third party approaches one side about a qualifying resort opportunity, that side must introduce the other so it can try to negotiate for the management or franchise opportunity. The agreement requires written notices, uses Illinois law except as limited by federal arbitration law and franchise-law jurisdiction rules, and sends disputes to ICC arbitration in New York in English. It also includes confidentiality, limits on punitive damages, anti-corruption obligations, and standard contract terms like amendment, assignment, severability, and binding effect.
